source9ContourObservations: The thin northern stem and lobed southwestern body are visible inside the image; no frame clipping is involved.

The broad white Murom label band reaches/crosses the eastern lobe edge near x467–469,y173–178. That area is also close to the black dashed railway. The displayed label/rail/boundary marks do not yield one unambiguous complete literal outer-stroke pixel path in this pass.

A pure saturated-purple mask would carve the white label out of the eastern perimeter. Treating that notch as the named complete outer footprint, or bridging it automatically, would change the interpretation.
